relevant_laws.quote: The driver of a vehicle approaching a yield sign if required for safety to stop shall stop before entering the crosswalk on the nearest side of the intersection or, if there is no crosswalk, at a clearly marked stop line, or if none, then at the point nearest the intersecting highway where the driver has a view of approaching traffic on the intersecting highway.
relevant_laws.notes: Frozen yield-sign travel cell; safety-stop necessity remains source-dependent.
